description: R16 phase diagram seed expansion: 15 experiments for Pythia-410M fp32 T=10 transition region
rationale: R16 reviewer requires ≥8 seeds in transition region. Current: α=0.45 (2 seeds), α=0.50 (3 seeds), α=0.55 (1 seed). Target: α=0.45 (7), α=0.50 (8), α=0.55 (6).

experiments.command: python -u iterative_train.py --model_name EleutherAI/pythia-410m --data_dir data/wikitext103_5k --synthetic_ratio 0.45 --num_generations 10 --steps_per_gen 5000 --output_dir results/phase_diagram/t10_a045_s44_fp32 --seed 44 --batch_size 4 --max_length 512 --lr 5e-5 --gen_max_new_tokens 256 --gen_batch_size 16 --top_p 0.95 --optim adamw_torch
experiments.hypothesis: α=0.45 seed 44: additional seed for transition region boundary. Existing seeds (42,43) show 0/8 PermG at T=10. Expect consistent null detection below α_c.
